about: The engine's neutral vocabulary (docs/packs/format.md, section 'Mechanics'). A pack maps its own mechanic names to these ids in rules.json 'mechanics'. kind: keyword = a tag a card can carry from its data and that the engine reads; hook = the card has a hook of this kind (shown to players, no tag); marker = a hint for the client only; state = a tag the engine sets during a game (a pack may name it, cards do not carry it). silenced = Silence removes it.
